# T-3: Shape command output

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Return plugin and upgrade results in both JSON and human CLI output, and expose `--no-upgrade` in help for supported commands.

## Acceptance Criteria
- install JSON output contains package result and upgrade result.
- update-all JSON output contains packages array and upgrade result.
- Human output contains plugin result lines followed by one upgrade result line.
- Help metadata includes `--no-upgrade` only for install and update-all.

## Implementation Notes
Keep human output aligned with the existing one-result-per-line `formatLine` style. Do not add `--no-upgrade` to sync or source update help.

## Test Strategy
Use spec-local JSON parsing assertions for install, update-all, no-update, and failure cases. Update existing help e2e coverage if command metadata output changes.
